name: Almásfüzitő (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, green, white and green, charged in the lower part of the white with the municipal arms of Almásfüzitő (a white and blue shield with a tree and crossed tools) above the name ALMÁSFÜZITŐ in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
